results.name: Chicken - rigged
results.description:
Lowpoly chicken rigged in blender and animated with a variety of actions:

* standing idle - moves head a bit
* sitting idle - plumps and fluffs - moves head
* stratch and peck - moves foot and pecks ground
* walking
* sitting down
* standing up (from sitting)

results.name: Halva the Chicken
results.description:
Halva is a low poly, painterly textured thuringian bearded hen with an idle pose animation. She was created for a freelance contract and is now allowed to roam my portfolio as well. I used a highpoly to lowpoly workflow in 3ds Max and Z-Brush, baked maps with xNormal and finally textured in Photoshop and the Quixel Suite 2. I tried to create a hybrid between handpainted and PBR materials for a unique look.

("Halva" refers to a greek dessert that I snacked on during the modeling process!)

results.name: Stylized Low-Poly Chicken
results.description: An optimized, low-poly stylized chicken model designed for indie games, mobile projects, and casual environments. Features custom hand-baked noise bump textures on the body for a soft, feather-like feel, contrasted with flat-shaded accent details. Built using a simple intersecting mesh workflow for efficient performance. Rigged.
